patch_scope: Bounded date checks recognize Turkish ablative day forms as complete compounds, including gurresinden, while preserving year exclusion and rejecting incorrect days. CSV verification accepts complete biography fields larger than the default CSV parser limit, checks their full content against SQLite and restores the caller's limit. The regression uses synthetic content; source readings, quotations, native dates and entity counts are unchanged.
test_dependencies: Full suite with pdf and dev extras; zero skips or warnings.
unit_test_runs: fresh installed wheel outside checkout: 46 passed, zero skips
independent_regression_cases_basis: The separate 55-case regression receipt is from the v0.1.3 numerical patch and was not rerun for v0.1.7. The current complete 46-test suite, including the bounded ablative-day and long-field export changes, passed in both the checkout and a fresh installed wheel.
verification_scope: Local release preparation: fresh wheel and sdist installations, standalone ZIP execution, bilingual demos, payload mirrors, schema/provenance checks, and both PDFs. Public tag installation and downloaded release assets require a separate check after publication.
